# ZENITY Smart Ring

> ZENITY is a smart ring for cross-faith meditation practice. It combines HRV
> (heart-rate-variability) monitoring, rotation counting (prayer-bead style),
> haptic meditation timers, and a patented nested two-ring design (smart inner
> ring + gemstone outer ring). Supported traditions: Buddhism, Daoism,
> Christianity, Islam, Judaism.

## Key facts

- Product: ZENITY Assembled Ring (smart inner ring + gemstone outer ring)
- Sensors: PPG HRV / heart-rate sensor, 6-axis gyroscope, haptic motor
- Battery: 7 days; Water resistance: IP68; Price: USD 299 (pre-order)
- Metrics: HRV "One-Pointedness" (ekaggata) index, RSA breath depth,
  drowsiness/agitation detection
- Practices supported: Buddha-name counting, breath meditation, Daoist
  wheel-turning (Minor Heavenly Cycle), Rosary, Centering Prayer, Jesus Prayer,
  Tasbih/Dhikr (33/99 groupings), five daily prayers, Berakhot, Sefirat HaOmer,
  Shabbat mode
- Spiritual energy: meditation sessions convert to ZEN energy credentials with
  blockchain hash verification ("Merit Ledger")
